query: SET time_zone='+00:00'; SELECT JSON_OBJECT('version',version,'script',script,'checksum',checksum,'success',success,'installed_utc',installed_on,'installed_native_epoch',UNIX_TIMESTAMP(installed_on),'captured_utc',UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),'captured_native_epoch',UNIX_TIMESTAMP(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),'session_timezone',@@session.time_zone) FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version='013.1';
